name: Orc
summary: Fierce raiders driven by strength and fury. Orcs charge into battle and keep pressing toward the enemy.

age.summary: Orcs mature at 12 and live up to about 50 years.

size.description: Orcs are usually over 6 feet tall and weigh 230 to 280 pounds.

speed.description: Your base walking speed is 30 feet.

languages.description: You can speak, read, and write Common and Orc.

features.name: Darkvision
features.summary: You see in dim light within 60 feet as if it were bright light, and in darkness as if it were dim light (shades of gray only).

features.name: Aggressive
features.summary: As a bonus action, you can move up to your speed toward a hostile creature you can see.

features.name: Menacing
features.summary: You are proficient in the Intimidation skill.

features.name: Powerful Build
features.summary: You count as one size larger when working out your carrying capacity and the weight you can push, drag or lift.
